findings.reason: The cited evidence confirms the KPI deviations on CORE-DNS-01 and the runbook description of the impact, supporting the inference of core DNS degradation as the cause.
T6 explicitly states the onset for both metrics is 2026-09-29 14:30, and the anomaly records confirm the specific drops and spikes.
T4 and T5 both report no changes on CORE-DNS-01 and its parents between 12:00 and 19:00, covering the incident window.
T8 reports no maintenance windows scheduled on CORE-DNS-01 and its parents during the specified time window.
T9 reports no external events for all regions between 12:00 and 19:00, matching the claim.
T2 shows nationwide latency rising and traffic dipping, and RB-DNS-DEGRADATION#02 states radio signalling metrics remain unaffected, supporting the claim.
